description: LIVE: buy or sell a total size_usd evenly over duration_minutes (TWAP). Felix runs it: every slice is a live market order under this key, within the key's caps and the account's risk rules, so this moves real money until it completes or you cancel_twap. Instrument format perp:SYM or lighter:SYM. Each slice is at least $10 and at least 30 seconds apart (default one slice a minute). price_limit is the worst price you accept: a buy waits while the price is above it, a sell while it is below. idempotency_key is required; reuse it to retry the exact same request, never a new key for the same TWAP. At most 10 run per account. Follow progress with get_twap.

duration_minutes.description: How long to spread it over, 5 to 1440 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required retry-safety key (8-128 characters). The same key always means the same TWAP.

instrument.description: perp:SYM or lighter:SYM, for example perp:BTC.

leverage.description: Optional leverage, default 1, up to the venue maximum.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce an existing position; never open or flip.

size_usd.description: Total notional in USD across all slices (at least 10).

slices.description: Optional number of slices. Default: one a minute. Each slice must be at least $10 and 30 seconds apart.

name: start_twap
